visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Listener List Instead of Hard-Wired Objects
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The Market creates one Alice and one Bob object itself and calls each of them by name. Let outsiders subscribe through a Listener interface instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The Market no longer knows who is listening. Any class implementing Listener can subscribe, and the two nearly identical classes become one.

tests.pattern: (?<![\s\S])\s*Alice sees ACME at 120[ \t]*\r?\nBob sees ACME at 120\s*(?![\s\S])
